svg.text: Two ways to reach the same device
The device answers with text laid out for a person to read. A script must
pull the values out by position, and any change to the layout breaks it.
The device answers with named fields. A parser reads a value by its name,
so the script keeps working when the output grows or is reordered.
Both paths are legitimate. The command line works on every device you own,
including ones too old to offer an interface. The structured path is more
reliable where it exists, which is why most sites end up running both.
